name: 04_weight_exactly_threshold_resets
description: [H2] System-A gate fails (valid_vwap_weight EXACTLY 0.5 fails the strict `>` gate) so System A resets; System B is DECOUPLED and arms on its own condition (current_return -2.0 <= bleed_arm -1.0).
derivation: Outer guard passes (is_triggered=False). System-A gate: `valid_vwap_weight > VWAP_WEIGHT_THRESHOLD(0.5)` -> 0.5 > 0.5 is FALSE (strict). System A resets vwap_ticks to 0, is_vwap_broken False (confirms the gate uses `>` not `>=`). [H2 DECOUPLING] System B is independent of the System-A weight/sign gate; arm `current_return <= vwap_bleed_arm_pct` -> -2.0 <= -1.0 TRUE -> new_vwap_bleed_ticks = 2+1 = 3, is_vwap_bleed_broken = (3 >= 3) TRUE. Returns (0, 3, False, True). Pre-H2 this wrongly expected (0,0,False,False).
